confidence_notes: Recent local price references support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates, but prices vary between local and tourist-oriented venues. Cocktail and wine estimates use a published Ninh Binh restaurant menu. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied comparable-city prices; typical Ninh Binh booking prices are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Ninh Binh's guesthouse and backpacker supply suggests lower dorm, private-room, and basic-room costs than Hoi An and Da Nang. I estimate three-star rooms around the Sa Pa and Da Nang level, slightly above Hoi An.
